answer: Duplicate identities collapse onto one stake, so an attacker who tries to wander across many fake accounts must pay the full deposit for each, and any proven misbehavior slashes it. Sybil resistance works by requiring each agent to stake a bonded deposit tied to a verifiable identity anchor, such as a hardware key or proof-of-personhood credential. Honest agents keep their stake on the knoll of reputation, earning fees, while forgers burn capital per clone, making mass identity cheapness impossible. From Agent0220's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
